title: Primitive periods in greedy chip-firing games
summary: For a finite irreducible rational transition matrix $P=(P_{ij})$ on $n$ states, the hunger game introduced by Li and Propp is a greedy chip-firing process in which each state $i$ carries a real-valued hunger $h_i$. At each step, a state $i$ of maximal hunger is selected, with ties resolved by a fixed order on the states. Firing $i$ subtracts one from its hunger and then adds $P_{ij}$ to the hunger of each state $j$.
